job.style: a diary entry or letter by a student

response.passage: October 14th. Dear Diary, tonight was magical. My uncle, Mr. Sharma, took me and my cousin Rohan to the outskirts of Dehradun to watch the meteor shower. We reached the open field at 8:30 PM, far away from the city lights. The sky was incredibly clear because the lack of pollution allowed the stars to shine brightly. I felt like an astronaut floating in space. Rohan kept pointing at the constellations, but I was busy counting the shooting stars. By midnight, I had spotted 12 distinct streaks of light crossing the dark horizon. Mr. Sharma told us that we were lucky to witness such a clear view. I am so tired now, but my heart is full of wonder. It is amazing how a simple night under the stars can make you feel so small yet so connected to the universe. I hope we can go back again next month when the moon is not so bright.
response.summary: A student describes a memorable night spent stargazing near Dehradun with family. They observed a meteor shower and felt a deep connection to the universe.
